items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Thomas MacNeil. Wendell MacNeil was his name. Wendell MacNeil. And my daddy and Albert Glenny. And they used to wake us up with serenaders.

ctx.x: Thomas MacNeil. Wendell MacNeil was his name. Wendell MacNeil. And my daddy and Albert Glenny. And they used to wake us up with serenaders. Two o'clock in the morning.
I thought I needed to win that phrase.
